claim: RDS takes automated backups during the backup window as a storage volume snapshot of the whole DB instance, not of individual databases, and saves them according to the backup retention period that you specify.

evidence.quote: Amazon RDS creates and saves automated backups of your DB instance or Multi-AZ DB cluster during the backup window of your DB instance. RDS creates a storage volume snapshot of your DB instance, backing up the entire DB instance and not just individual databases. RDS saves the automated backups of your DB instance according to the backup retention period that you specify.
